_meta.what: The nightly brain job's experiment queue (scorecard v3). pick_experiment.py chooses ONE item per night; every result goes to ledger.jsonl.
rules: Exactly one queue item per night: the highest-priority QUEUED auto item whose preconditions all pass.
No auto item eligible -> MEASURE the top eligible jake item to price its proposal (never applies; record 'priced').
An auto item applies only through the dual-run gate: gate.py exit 0 (v1 bar AND v3 gate), with a verified backup + exact undo.
Watch series are capped at 3 nights; the nightly never opens a new series (it never adds items).
A rejected item is re-queued only with a NEW hypothesis (pick_experiment.py requeue).

vars.$SNAP: tonight's measured, sha-verified snapshot of the brain (e.g. /tmp/brain-snap-YYYYMMDD) — never the live dir
vars.$BRAIN_EVAL: the brain-eval/ dir of the nightly worktree

measure: python3 gate.py --base B3-$NIGHT --cand C3-<id>-$NIGHT --v1-base B1-$NIGHT --v1-cand C1-<id>-$NIGHT --json   # exit 0 = APPLY allowed
jake-lane pricing / measure-only: v3 --no-llm runs + `gate.py --v3-only` (prices, never applies)
